Description: Where the ship was built as Black Star (yard number 2284) and launched on 29 December 1966. Pin placed at an approximate port position; the ship's slipway is not recorded.
Moved here from the Clyde in April 1972 for Royal Navy completion. Departure point of the 1977 voyage home. Pin placed at an approximate port position; the ship's berth is not recorded.

Refitted here to Royal Navy standards after the move south in April 1972, before commissioning as HMS Mermaid in May 1973. Pin placed at an approximate port position; the ship's berth is not recorded.
Place of commissioning as KD Hang Tuah on 22 July 1977. Pin placed at an approximate port position; the ship's berth is not recorded.
HMS Mermaid was based at Singapore during her Far East service. Representative point only; her base berth is not recorded.
Area patrolled by HMS Mermaid during the Third Cod War, 1976. Representative point for a sea area, not a recorded position.
Labelled on the route map of the 'Kepulangan ke Tanahair' panel; not mentioned in the panel text and no date given. Pin placed at an approximate port position; the ship's berth is not recorded.
Labelled on the route map of the 'Kepulangan ke Tanahair' panel; not mentioned in the panel text and no date given. Pin placed at an approximate port position; the ship's berth is not recorded.
Seven-day call from 10 to 17 September 1977, documented on the on-board panel. Pin placed at an approximate port position; the ship's berth is not recorded.

Named as a port of call in the panel text. The panel map labels it 'Abu Dabi, Saudi Arabia' and its arrow does not point to the Gulf, so the identification is disputed. Pin placed at an approximate port position; the ship's berth is not recorded.
Named as a port of call in the panel text; date not given. Pin placed at an approximate port position; the ship's berth is not recorded.
Named as a port of call in the panel text; the panel map gives a planned departure (ETD) of 9 October 1977. Pin placed at an approximate port position; the ship's berth is not recorded.
First Malaysian port reached, at 9.00 am on 14 October 1977. Pin placed at an approximate port position; the ship's berth is not recorded.
Two-day call on 16 and 17 October 1977. Pin placed at an approximate port position; the ship's berth is not recorded.
Royal Malaysian Navy base at Woodlands, Singapore, until 1997. KD Hang Tuah arrived here on 18 October 1977. Coordinates from Wikipedia.
TLDM headquarters from 1984. Scene of the 2018 museum-ship designation, the 2025 decommissioning and the 2026 handover. Coordinates from Wikipedia; the museum's future berth has not been published.
Shipyard (now Malaysia Marine and Heavy Engineering) where the 1995–1997 re-engining was carried out. Pin placed at an approximate port position; the ship's position in the yard is not recorded.
